item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa bzod par gsol/ 'di bzhengs dge ba'i mthu stobs kyis/ bdag sogs phyi rabs rjes 'breng rnams/ lta spyod zung 'brel don gnyis mthar phyin shog bstan pa'i rgyal po g.yung drung bon 'di dag mkha' la nyi shar mun pa'i tshogs 'joms bzhin/ sems can kun gyi dpal du 'gyur bar shog/
